intro: Utopia is where routines become rituals. Crafted from solid Sheesham, it brings warmth, purpose, and presence to everyday moments at your mirror.

features.title: Crafted to last decades
features.text: Made from solid North Indian Sheesham, our dresser brings long life, rich colour, and timeless appeal.

features.title: Wood that tells its own story
features.text: Each piece is hand-finished, revealing grain patterns that make every unit truly one-of-a-kind.

features.title: We hold your every day
features.text: With a drawer and open shelf, you get both function and flow for daily essentials.

features.title: Integrated stool for convenience
features.text: Comes with a matching built-in stool that enhances functionality while ensuring comfort, making your daily grooming sessions effortless and enjoyable.

features.title: A mirror into quiet rituals
features.text: Equipped with a full-sized 3mm mirror, it offers a clear and complete view, making it perfect for getting ready with confidence.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
